751-3286-3480.description:

When Shrieking Drake enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Shrieking Drake by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.

Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Chalk Outline trigger.
Resolve the Chalk Outline trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Repeat.

567-1981-2415-6495.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
567-1981-2415-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Soul's Attendant triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
567-1981-2415-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1170-5131-5226-7010--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-5131-5226-7010--202.notablePrerequisites: There are at least three Lesson cards in your graveyard.

Activate Lithatog by sacrificing the artifact, giving Lithatog +1/+1 until end of turn
Repeat.

549-6620-6871--183.manaNeeded: {0} plus the cost of the creature that earthbends
549-6620-6871--183.description:
Cast the earthbending creature by paying its mana cost.
When you cast that spell, you lose 1 life and create a 2/2 artifact creature token.
The earthbending creature enters as an artifact land creature due to Biotransference and Toph.
When that creature enters, it earthbends, causing itself to become a land creature with haste, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on itself, and creating a delayed triggered ability.
Activate Sylvan Safekeeper by sacrificing that creature.
When that creature dies, the delayed ability from step 4 triggers, causing it to return to the battlefield tapped as an artifact land creature.
Repeat from step 3 any number of times.
Resolve all activated abilities from Sylvan Safekeeper.

3179-3641-4399-4518.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Oketra's Monument.
Defiler of Faith and Oketra's Monument trigger.
Resolve the Defiler of Faith trigger, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Distinguished Conjurer triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve the Oketra's Monument trigger, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token.
When the Warrior enters, Distinguished Conjurer triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Distinguished Conjurer trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Distinguished Conjurer trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
3179-3641-4399-4518.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

2350-4200-6867-7183.description:
Cast Appa either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {W}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Icewind Stalwart with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Icewind Stalwart from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Icewind Stalwart enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

141-997-7682.notablePrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard with mana value 4 or less.
141-997-7682.description:
Cast Lively Dirge by paying {1}{B} plus an additional {2} to select its second mode, targeting a card in your graveyard.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Lively Dirge.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Lively Dirge
Resolve the Lively Dirge copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

413-4302-5929.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
413-4302-5929.description:
Activate Blasting Station by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit token enters the battlefield as an Angel due to Leyline of Transformation, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Repeat.

240-4742-5147-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target
Repeat from step 2.

539-2713-4657.notablePrerequisites: You control two creatures excluding Magus of the Candelabra that do not have summoning sickness.
539-2713-4657.description:
Activate two creatures other than Magus of the Candelabra by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Magus of the Candelabra by paying {1} due to Zirda and tapping it, untapping it and the two other creatures.
Repeat.

140-2511-4484-4871-5643.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
140-2511-4484-4871-5643.notablePrerequisites: You've lost X or more life this turn.
140-2511-4484-4871-5643.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Bloodflow Connoisseur abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
140-2511-4484-4871-5643.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

628-2438-7197.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Loch Mare.
When Loch Mare dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability
Repeat.

57-4846-4927-5904.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{U}{R}.
57-4846-4927-5904.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Activate Adric by paying {2}{U} and tapping it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

When the Eldrazi Spawn enters, Glaring Fleshraker's second ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve Omarthis, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Glaring Fleshraker's second ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Omarthis.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Omarthis, adding {C}{C}.
When Omarthis dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Omarthis from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3000-4050-4770-6090.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {1}{W}.
When Whitemane Lion enters the battlefield, it and Arahbo trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Arahbo trigger, creating a 1/1 Cat and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Cat and Squirrel, adding {1}{W}.
Repeat.

Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Timeless Witness.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Timeless Witness that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Timeless Witness token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Timeless Witness from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Gilded Lotus.
Repeat.

3259-4359--95.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and the creature with mobilize as attackers, triggering the creature with mobilize, creating at least one 1/1 Warrior creature token that is tapped and attacking.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Warrior token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

Resolve the Sarkhan trigger, either choosing a Dragon you control or revealing a Dragon card from your hand and creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Sarkhan.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

Resolve the Blazing Rootwalla trigger from step 2, causing you to pay {0} to cast it from exile.

Repeat from step 1.

Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Resolve the second Filigree Sages ability, untapping Gilded Lotus.
Repeat.

Pass the turn.
Activate Possessed Skaab, by tapping it, creating a token copy of it with haste.
The token copy of Possessed Skaab enters the battlefield, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

228-1232-1295-4277.description:
